week 1.personal line written for them: You are in that contest right now. The doubt about your past consistency is a ram, and the work you could do today is the other. You do not need to win the whole week today.

week 1.verse line: Do tomorrow's work today, and the afternoon's in the morning. Time doesn't wait for you to be ready.
week 1.personal line written for them: Your studying has a real goal, and the doubt is just noise. Open the book you keep avoiding. Start with one paragraph. Let the work speak for itself.

week 1.verse line: Steadiness comes from doing. No one becomes steady without acting; act, and steadiness follows.
week 1.personal line written for them: You are building a future through study, but doubt is spending the energy you would use to begin. The texts say steadiness comes from doing, not from waiting for the right mood. Your resolve is real. The test is that the work feels too large, so you sit and stare.

week 1.story: Karunya stops acting: knowledge and action as two wings
week 1.summary: A student asks the sage Agastya whether freedom comes from action or from knowledge. Agastya answers with a story: young Karunya, confused by two scriptures, simply stopped doing anything, and his father had to show him that understanding and action work together.
week 1.lesson: Don't freeze while you wait to be sure. Understanding and action have to fly together.
week 1.personal line written for them: Karunya stopped everything to get the answer right first. You are standing at the same point, waiting to feel ready before you begin. The story says knowledge and action are the two wings of one bird. You do not need to choose between understanding and doing.

plan_B.first words shown with Day 1: You are ready to stick with your timetable for the UPSC prelims in May, and the steady do not step off the right path.

week 1.verse line: Let them praise or blame, let money come or go: the steady don't step off the right path.
week 1.personal line written for them: You have your timetable and a clear mind. The noise of praise or blame does not move you. Stay on the path you have chosen today.

week 1.verse line: We act only when we find joy in it. Understand the joy, and action follows.
Free of clinging and boasting, full of resolve and enthusiasm, unchanged by success or failure: the best kind of doer.
week 1.personal line written for them: You are ready to follow the timetable through May. This is the steadiness and enthusiasm that makes the doer sattvic.

week 1.verse line: Take in big joys and big sorrows the way the ocean takes in rivers: evenly.
pay as much attention to the means of work as to its end.
In a crisis, you may be shaken inside. Don't let fear make your decisions for you.

week 1.story: In the middle of the hardest day, they stop to water the horses
week 1.summary: The sun is moving, his life is forfeit at sunset, and Jayadratha is still miles behind layers of the enemy. Krishna says: the horses are exhausted and wounded, they need water and there is none here.
week 1.lesson: Those who carry you must be cared for, most of all when there is no time.

person.their note: My dog Bruno died on Sunday. He was with me for twelve years, through everything. The flat is so quiet now.

plan_A.first words shown with Day 1: You are alone with this, and the quiet is loud, just as Yudhishthira saw friends leave when the tree had no fruit.

week 1.reference: Mahabharata · Udyoga Parva · Udyoga: Krishna's peace embassy
week 1.verse line: When money runs out, some friends drift away, like birds leaving a tree with no fruit.
week 1.personal line written for them: You are alone with this, and the quiet is loud, just as Yudhishthira saw friends leave when the tree had no fruit.

week 1.reference: Mahabharata · Shanti Parva · Shanti: Consolation of Yudhishthira
week 1.verse line: Mental pain comes from two places: something you didn't want happened, or your mind is spinning. No third.
week 1.personal line written for them: The silence of the flat is the sound of a life that was. What you are feeling is the weight of that twelve-year presence leaving. The flat is quiet, and your mind is spinning with what it is no longer.

week 1.reference: Complete Works, Vol. 8, Epistles – Fourth Series, CLVI, p. 493
week 1.verse line: if it were possible to exchange grief, and had I a cheerful mind, I would exchange mine for your grief ever and always.
week 1.personal line written for them: The flat is quiet now, and the loss sits with you alone. Someone who knows the weight of loss would carry this grief with you, if it could be exchanged.

week 1.verse line: the man who never loves, who is hard and stony, escaping most of the miseries of life, escapes also its joys.
week 1.personal line written for them: The flat is quiet now because you loved him for twelve years. That same love made the silence loud. It is the price of having him.

week 1.verse line: Feed people, find water for animals; when even ants live off your home, you become a world for them.
week 1.personal line written for them: The flat is quiet now that Bruno is gone. That quiet is real. The care you gave him for twelve years made him your world, and his presence made you a world for him. That bond remains.

week 1.verse line: Heat and cold, pleasure and pain come and go. They don't last; learn to bear them.
week 1.personal line written for them: The quiet of the flat after Bruno is a real loss. That silence is part of the pain that comes and goes. The twelve years you gave him are not erased by this quiet.

week 1.story: Hanuman reaches Sita
week 1.summary: Sita, captive and threatened by Ravana, has nearly lost hope; only the guard Trijata has been kind. Hanuman drops Ram's ring from a tree, then tells her Ram's whole story. Sita says he has been her ship in a sea of separation; he gives her Ram's message that speaking of pain helps, but there is...
week 1.lesson: When someone is near despair, a message that they are remembered can carry them.

week 2.verse line: Even winning everything wouldn't touch this grief that's drying me up inside.
week 2.personal line written for them: You are alone with this grief, and nothing on earth or in heaven could ease it. The flat is quiet because Bruno is not here anymore. Let this sorrow be what it is.

week 2.verse line: From the pull of want and push of dislike comes the confusion that traps every being.
Rich or poor, happy or sad, flawed or not, a friend is your greatest refuge.
Your wisdom isn't gone. Grief has only put it to sleep for a while.
week 2.personal line written for them: Your wisdom is not gone. It has only been sleeping. The quiet of the flat is the silence around a resting mind.

week 2.verse line: Steadiness comes from doing. No one becomes steady without acting; act, and steadiness follows.
week 2.personal line written for them: The flat is so quiet now. You gave Bruno twelve years of steady care. That doing built a steadiness in you that still remains, even when the house is silent.

week 2.verse line: Whoever can ride out the surge of desire and anger, here and now, is steady and happy.

week 2.story: Kunti watches her sons and daughter-in-law walk into exile
week 2.summary: Kunti is too old for the forest, so Vidura will keep her in his house. She watches her five sons leave in deerskins, heads down, mocked by Duhshasana. Draupadi comes to take her leave in a single stained garment with her hair loose.
week 2.lesson: A parent's part, when the children must go, is to bless them truthfully and bear the waiting.
week 2.personal line written for them: You are alone with the silence after Bruno is gone. That quiet is a real weight. The waiting is part of loving him. You do not have to fill it today.

week 3.verse line: Speaking of pain lightens it. But whom can I tell? No one knows this ache.
Confusion is the root illness. Anger is the bile that keeps your chest burning.
When you see the same life in everyone, where is there room for confusion or grief?
week 3.personal line written for them: You feel the silence of the flat. The bond you had with Bruno was a real presence. That same life is in him and in you.

week 3.verse line: The divine lives in the heart of every being, yours included.
week 3.personal line written for them: The quiet of the flat is not empty of him. The same presence that sat with you for twelve years still moves inside you, turning the wheel of your days. Let the Lord be the quiet you sit with now.

week 3.verse line: Inwardly hand all your work to the divine, hold it as your goal, and keep your mind on it.
Feel others' joy and pain as if they were your own. That is the highest practice.
week 3.personal line written for them: The flat is so quiet now because Bruno took the sound with him. His joy and your grief lived in the same twelve years. In that shared rhythm, you already practiced what the highest yogi knows.

week 3.story: Jatayu's last fight and Ram's grief
week 3.summary: Ram returns to an empty hut and searches the forest, asking birds and trees if they have seen Sita. He finds the old vulture Jatayu dying; he had fought Ravana alone to stop the abduction. Ram tells him that for one whose heart is set on others' good, nothing is out of reach, and performs his...
week 3.lesson: Standing up for someone matters, even when you cannot win.
week 3.personal line written for them: The quiet of the flat is a heavy thing right now. Bruno walked with you through so much, and the space he leaves is real. Even the highest grieve openly for the one they love; grief that keeps walking finds its way.

plan_B.first words shown with Day 1: My pet died

week 1.verse line: Others, not knowing these paths, learn by listening to others, and they too cross over.
week 1.personal line written for them: You are searching for what it is all for. You are listening to others about purpose and roots. You do not need to find a new reason to carry you.

week 1.verse line: Like people walking daily over buried gold, we pass our own treasure every day and never find it.
week 1.personal line written for them: You are walking over your own roots every day without knowing it. The search you feel is not for a new place. It is for the ground beneath your feet. What you need is already under your daily route. Let your feet recognize the soil they stand on.

week 1.verse line: Take heart. Trouble touches everyone; it flares up like fire and passes.
week 1.personal line written for them: You are feeling the weight of the pet's absence, and the work around you feels hollow right now. Lakshman's words are for a moment when grief wants to burn everything down. The trouble is real, but it is not permanent. It flares up like fire and passes.

week 1.verse line: Not begging for gain, not grieving loss: a steady mind stays cool and full.
week 1.personal line written for them: You are looking for something deeper to lean on after the loss of your pet, and the texts call this searching for what it is all for.

week 1.verse line: Don't think less of yourself or settle for little. Set your mind on something good, and stop fearing.
week 1.personal line written for them: You are in the quiet after the storm. The reasons that used to carry you feel thin. This verse does not ask you to pretend the ground is firm again.

week 1.verse line: Inwardly hand all your work to the divine, hold it as your goal, and keep your mind on it.
week 1.personal line written for them: You have been carrying the weight of purpose alone, as if you could find it through effort, comparison, or achievement. This counsel asks you to hand that search over. Offer your daily work, even the empty hours, to something larger than your own ambition, and hold that as the goal.

week 1.story: Satyakama Jabala, the honest boy
week 1.summary: A boy who wants to study asks his mother about his father's lineage. She tells him frankly she does not know, and he repeats this word for word to the teacher. The teacher accepts him for his honesty, sends him off with 400 weak cows, and the boy returns years later with a thousand, having...
week 1.lesson: Honesty about who you are is the best credential you can bring.
week 1.personal line written for them: You want to reconnect with your roots, and maybe that is why the loss of your pet sits so heavy. Satyakama Jabala did not know his father, and his mother told him to say exactly that.

week 2.verse line: Like a poor man before the wishing tree, we hesitate to ask for what we really want.
week 2.personal line written for them: You have outgrown the old reasons that used to carry you. You are looking for something deeper to lean on now. The doubt you feel is not a sign that you are too late. It is the hesitation of someone who has finally found the tree.

week 2.verse line: 'This is done, this is next, this is half-done.' Life slips by while we keep busy like this.
week 2.personal line written for them: You are busy with work and the search for purpose, and the days are passing. Medhavin's warning is not about fear, but about the cost of waiting. The work you do today is the only one you can claim as your own. The searching you do is the work itself.

week 2.verse line: Don't chase the future or brood on the past. Meet this moment with a smile.
week 2.personal line written for them: You are in your own garden, hearing a song that makes you question the work you do every day. You do not have to quit your job or your search to find something deeper.

week 2.verse line: Knowing this, the wise stop arguing. Their joy is within, and they stay fully active.
week 2.personal line written for them: Turn inward, come to know the self, and let your work become service and offering; a life lived from there is full.

week 2.verse line: Your work is yours to do; the results are not yours to hold. Don't let that make you stop.
week 2.personal line written for them: Turn toward what lasts: serve, study, reflect daily, and offer your work to something beyond yourself.

week 2.verse line: Turn to doing good after a wrong, and you come out like the moon from behind a cloud.
week 2.personal line written for them: Nothing is exactly wrong, and that's the hard part. You've outgrown the reasons that used to carry you.

week 2.summary: Six earnest seekers come to the sage Pippalada with questions. Instead of answering, he asks them to live with him for a year in discipline and faith, and only promises to answer what he actually knows.
week 2.lesson: Readiness matters, and a good teacher only claims what he knows.
week 2.personal line written for them: You have been waiting for a sign of purpose since your pet died, and now you are looking for something deeper to lean on. Pippalada did not rush the seekers with answers, and neither will you rush your own search.

week 3.verse line: One God is hidden in every being: the inner self of all, the quiet witness of all we do.
